article.title: Typography study
body: A demo study in scale, contrast, and hierarchy. Large letterforms give the composition a clear focal point, while a restrained palette keeps the smaller details readable.
The aim is to make a few elements carry the whole poster. Type, spacing, a single shape, and a short line of copy each have a specific job.
